items.title_en: Cisco tops Fortune’s list of best technology workplaces for 2026
items.title_zh: 思科荣登《财富》2026 年最佳技术工作场所排行榜榜首
items.summary_en: Cisco topped Fortune's ranking for the best workplaces in information technology.
items.summary_zh: 思科在《财富》杂志的信息技术最佳工作场所排名中名列前茅。

items.title_en: Meta officer reveals Mark Zuckerberg’s surprising WhatsApp habit: ‘How does he have time?’
items.title_zh: Meta 官员揭示了马克·扎克伯格令人惊讶的 WhatsApp 习惯：“他怎么有时间？”
items.summary_en: Before joining Meta, Alexandr Wang occasionally sought Zuckerberg’s business advice on WhatsApp, but was surprised by the detailed replies the busy CEO sent him.
items.summary_zh: 在加入 Meta 之前，Alexandr Wang 偶尔会在 WhatsApp 上寻求扎克伯格的商业建议，但对这位忙碌的首席执行官发给他的详细回复感到惊讶。

items.title_en: ‘8 months of hard work went to waste’: Bittu Tabahi finds Ajnar River littered again
items.title_zh: “8个月的努力付诸东流”：比图·塔巴希发现阿杰纳尔河再次乱七八糟
items.summary_en: Bittu Tabahi's video sparked a discussion about public responsibility and the recurring problem of people dumping waste into water bodies.
items.summary_zh: Bittu Tabahi 的视频引发了关于公共责任和人们向水体倾倒废物这一反复出现的问题的讨论。

items.title_en: Rs 1.69 lakh TV, phones: Why a Madurai man is flooded with fake COD orders
items.title_zh: 价值 16.9 万卢比的电视、电话：为什么一名马杜赖男子会收到大量假货到付款订单
items.summary_en: Madurai influencer Veeramani alleges strangers placed fake COD orders for TVs, refrigerators and smartphones after he shared his address for Diwali sweets.
items.summary_zh: 马杜赖网红 Veeramani 声称，在他分享了排灯节糖果的地址后，陌生人给电视、冰箱和智能手机下了虚假的货到付款订单。

items.title_en: Zohran Mamdani’s festive message celebrates Navratri’s many traditions
items.title_zh: Zohran Mamdani 的节日致辞庆祝了九夜节的众多传统
items.summary_en: Mamdani’s mention of regional festive traditions prompted users to share their own celebrations and greetings.
items.summary_zh: 马姆达尼提到的地区节日传统促使用户分享他们自己的庆祝活动和问候。
